| D2 concern | Current evidence | Audit result |
|---|---|---|

There is also no desktop deep-link handling. |
| OS secret storage | OAuth credentials go through `ProviderKeysStore`; in desktop that backend is P2P IPC. No Electron `safeStorage`/keychain adapter exists. | Missing required main-owned OS secret storage boundary. |
| Local Courses | Packaged Nitro creates user-data course/Pear directories and uses `/api/courses/session` for readiness. | Plausible source/package wiring only; no local course list/workspace/cookie/WebSocket exercised in a desktop window. |
| Sharing state | Share cache/settings use renderer `localStorage`; public share uses same-origin `/api/share`. | Web implementation is inherited, but no desktop persistence/share flow is exercised; it is not P2P-backed. |
| Persistence | P2P store is placed under Electron `userData`; web storage swaps to the P2P backend when preload exists. | Source plus headless startup only; no fresh-profile write → quit → reopen proof for sessions/artifacts/settings. |
| Package/runtime | `linux-unpacked` includes staged Nitro and the binary survived a 12-second headless launch. | Package/startup evidence, not an installed artifact or visible product verification. |

The OAuth issue is the most immediate code defect: [oauth.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/keating/oauth.ts:191) opens `about:blank`, while [main.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/desktop/src/main.ts:89) unconditionally denies it. Add a desktop runtime acceptance harness that launches `linux-unpacked` outside the checkout with a fresh user-data directory, verifies `/chat`, a real `/api/courses/session` local cookie response, session/artifact write–restart–restore, local sharing state, safe external navigation, and denied media permission recovery.
